title: Heading
description: Give the page a clear primary heading.
explanation: Give the page a clear primary heading.
usage: Use this when you need to give the page a clear primary heading.
mistakes: Use one primary h1 per page; choose heading levels by structure.

title: Paragraph
description: Add a readable paragraph of text.
explanation: Add a readable paragraph of text.
usage: Use this when you need to add a readable paragraph of text.
mistakes: Paragraphs cannot contain block elements such as div.

title: Button
description: Create a button for a JavaScript action.
explanation: Create a button for a JavaScript action.
usage: Use this when you need to create a button for a JavaScript action.
mistakes: A button inside a form defaults to submit unless type="button" is set.

title: Hyperlink
description: Link to another page or website.
explanation: Link to another page or website.
usage: Use this when you need to link to another page or website.
mistakes: Use meaningful link text and a real destination; avoid javascript: URLs.

title: Image
description: Show an image with accessible alternative text.
explanation: Show an image with accessible alternative text.
usage: Use this when you need to show an image with accessible alternative text.
mistakes: Describe the image in alt; width alone does not guarantee the file exists.

title: Unordered list
description: Group items whose order does not matter.
explanation: Group items whose order does not matter.
usage: Use this when you need to group items whose order does not matter.
mistakes: List items must be children of ul.

title: Ordered list
description: Present a sequence of steps.
explanation: Present a sequence of steps.
usage: Use this when you need to present a sequence of steps.
mistakes: Use ol when sequence matters, not just to get numbered styling.

title: Navigation
description: Provide labeled navigation links.
explanation: Provide labeled navigation links.
usage: Use this when you need to provide labeled navigation links.
mistakes: Use a distinct aria-label if a page has multiple nav landmarks.

title: Form
code:
<form action="/contact" method="post">
  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" name="email" type="email" required>
  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
description: Collect an email address for a server endpoint.
explanation: Collect an email address for a server endpoint.
usage: Use this when you need to collect an email address for a server endpoint.
output: An email field and a Send button
mistakes: The action URL needs a real server; this static app does not receive submissions.

title: Text input
description: Associate a visible label with a text input.
explanation: Associate a visible label with a text input.
usage: Use this when you need to associate a visible label with a text input.
mistakes: The label for value must match the input id exactly.

title: Table
description: Display structured data with column headings.
explanation: Display structured data with column headings.
usage: Use this when you need to display structured data with column headings.
mistakes: Use th for headers, and add scope so column relationships are clear.

title: Footer
description: Add a footer for copyright or contact details.
explanation: Add a footer for copyright or contact details.
usage: Use this when you need to add a footer for copyright or contact details.
mistakes: Use a real copyright owner and keep the year current.

title: Stylesheet link
description: Load a separate CSS file from the document head.
explanation: Load a separate CSS file from the document head.
usage: Use this when you need to load a separate CSS file from the document head.
mistakes: The CSS path is relative to the HTML file, not the computer root.

title: Script link
description: Load a JavaScript file after the document is parsed.
explanation: Load a JavaScript file after the document is parsed.
usage: Use this when you need to load a JavaScript file after the document is parsed.
mistakes: The script path must exist; defer waits for parsing before execution.

title: Section
code:
About

A little about this project.
description: Group related content under a heading.
explanation: Group related content under a heading.
usage: Use this when you need to group related content under a heading.
mistakes: aria-labelledby must match the section heading id.

title: Article
code:
Latest update

This story can stand on its own.
description: Mark up self-contained content.
explanation: Mark up self-contained content.
usage: Use this when you need to mark up self-contained content.
mistakes: An article should make sense as self-contained content.

title: Container
description: Group elements for layout or styling.
explanation: Group elements for layout or styling.
usage: Use this when you need to group elements for layout or styling.
mistakes: A div adds no meaning; prefer semantic elements when appropriate.

title: Dropdown
code:
<label for="course">Choose a course</label>
<select id="course" name="course">
  <option value="html">HTML</option>
  <option value="css">CSS</option>
</select>
description: Let the user select from predefined options.
explanation: Let the user select from predefined options.
usage: Use this when you need to let the user select from predefined options.
mistakes: Each option needs a value that your form handler understands.

title: Checkbox
description: Offer an independent on or off choice.
explanation: Offer an independent on or off choice.
usage: Use this when you need to offer an independent on or off choice.
mistakes: An unchecked checkbox is omitted from submitted form data.

title: Text area
description: Accept multiple lines of text.
explanation: Accept multiple lines of text.
usage: Use this when you need to accept multiple lines of text.
mistakes: textarea text goes between tags, not in a value attribute.

title: Video
code:
<video controls width="640">
  <source src="movie.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  <track kind="captions" src="captions.vtt" srclang="en" label="English" default>
</video>
description: Embed a video with controls and captions.
explanation: Embed a video with controls and captions.
usage: Use this when you need to embed a video with controls and captions.
mistakes: Provide captions and a real source file; autoplay is often blocked.

title: Audio
code: <audio controls src="audio.mp3">Your browser cannot play this audio.</audio>
description: Embed audio with playback controls.
explanation: Embed audio with playback controls.
usage: Use this when you need to embed audio with playback controls.
mistakes: The source must be a supported audio file; never rely on autoplay.

title: Details disclosure
code:
How does this work?

Click the summary to show or hide this answer.
description: Create an accessible expandable section.
explanation: Create an accessible expandable section.
usage: Use this when you need to create an accessible expandable section.
output: How does this work?  ▸ (expand to reveal the answer)
mistakes: Keep the summary as the first child of details.

title: Progress indicator
description: Show the completion of a task.
explanation: Show the completion of a task.
usage: Use this when you need to show the completion of a task.
mistakes: value must stay between zero and max.

title: Responsive picture
description: Select an image source based on screen width.
explanation: Select an image source based on screen width.
usage: Use this when you need to select an image source based on screen width.
mistakes: Keep img as the fallback; source alone does not render an image.

title: Skip navigation
code:
Skip to content

Page content
description: Let keyboard users skip repeated navigation.
explanation: Let keyboard users skip repeated navigation.
usage: Use this when you need to let keyboard users skip repeated navigation.
mistakes: The target ID must exist and be unique; main should be the page's main landmark.

title: Complete profile card
code:
Alex Morgan

Student and curious developer.

Say hello
description: Build a semantic profile card with a contact link.
explanation: Build a semantic profile card with a contact link.
usage: Use this when you need to build a semantic profile card with a contact link.
output:
Alex Morgan
Student and curious developer.
Say hello
mistakes: Use a real avatar path and contact address before publishing.
